answer: UNRESOLVED. 0 of 9 specification steps resolved. All blocked on step 1 (molecule design). See P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/ for the 9-step path.

1_executive_technology_brief.what_it_does: Converts intracranial pressure (ICP) into a chemical molecular signal in CSF, detectable by a wearable biosensor — eliminating all electronics, batteries, and RF from the intracranial implant.
1_executive_technology_brief.why_it_matters: Current ICP monitors require batteries (replacement surgery) and electronics in the brain (infection risk, RF interference). This platform eliminates all intracranial electronics.
1_executive_technology_brief.technical_differentiator: Genuinely new communication channel: chemical molecular signaling through CSF. No prior implant uses chemistry instead of electronics for ICP monitoring.
1_executive_technology_brief.honest_disclosure_R277: This is the HIGHEST-RISK, HIGHEST-DIFFERENTIATION package. The architecture is novel and defensible. But the molecule is UNSPECIFIED. The 9-step specification path (P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/) is blocked on step 1 (molecule design). The buyer is purchasing an architecture + research direction + 9-step specification path, NOT a buildable technology. There is a non-trivial probability that NO viable molecule exists.

2_mechanism_dossier.causal_chain: ICP changes → mechanical deformation of implant transducer → release rate of synthetic molecule changes proportionally → molecule transported through CSF → wearable biosensor detects concentration → ICP reconstructed remotely
2_mechanism_dossier.operating_states: Normal ICP: baseline release. Elevated ICP: increased release (proportional to pressure). Decreased ICP: decreased release.
2_mechanism_dossier.9_step_specification_path: See P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/architecture_concept_status.json. 0 of 9 steps resolved. All blocked on step 1 (molecule).

4_engineering_specification.molecule: UNSPECIFIED — see P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/01_molecule_design_requirements.json for the 7 functional requirements (FR-01 through FR-07) and 5 candidate molecule classes. Requires 12-24 months of medicinal chemistry research to resolve.
4_engineering_specification.transducer: Mechanical-to-chemical transducer. Three options: deformable porous membrane (ENGINEERABLE), phase-change (RESEARCH), mechanophore (RESEARCH). See P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/03_release_kinetics.json.
4_engineering_specification.sensor: Wearable biosensor detecting target molecule at nanomolar concentration. Three candidates: electrochemical aptamer (PROMISING), optical fluorescence (PROMISING if molecule fluorescent), mass-sensitive (LIKELY UNSUITABLE). See P-09_ARCHITECTURE_CONCEPT/06_external_sensor.json.

sensitivity_analysis.honest_label: MODELLED SCENARIO — NOT ECONOMIC PROOF. Highly speculative because molecule is unresolved. If molecule is found AND system works: $267M/year avoided cost. If molecule is NOT found: $0.
sensitivity_analysis.base_case: 100K patients × $20K/surgery ÷ 7.5 years = $267M/year avoided cost. Package $500K = 0.002x annual avoided cost.
sensitivity_analysis.critical_caveat: This entire model assumes the molecule research program succeeds. Probability of success is unknown — could be 5%, could be 50%. Buyer must treat this as a research investment with uncertain return.

Release failure (no ICP data — same as no monitor, not unsafe)

13_safety_package.safe_states: If system fails → patient has NO ICP monitoring (same as no implant). Must NOT interfere with standard shunt drainage.

14_integration_package.how_it_plugs_in: Transducer integrated into shunt reservoir. Wearable sensor is separate device. No modification to shunt drainage function.
